d.ko: Head to the USA and grow your own business with a realistic and relaxing lawn mowing experience! Featuring brand new grass tech, the addition of leaf-blowing plus reworked systems based on player feedback to the original - including licensed equipment from Kubota, STIGA and SCAGⓇ!

d.zh: 前往美国，在惬意而真实的草坪修剪体验中，打造属于自己的事业！ 游戏不仅引入了全新的草坪技术，还新增了落叶吹扫玩法。同时，我们结合玩家反馈全面优化了前作的多项系统，并带来了 Kubota、STIGA 与 SCAG® 的官方授权设备！
